examples_json:
[{"quickstart":{"display_name":"CAGRA","use_this_when":"Use this for graph-based approximate search over an evaluated dataset.","sql":"SELECT *
FROM cuvs_cagra(
  dataset => (SELECT id, d0, d1 FROM dataset_vectors),
  queries => (SELECT id, d0, d1 FROM query_vectors),
  k => 8,
  metric => 'l2_expanded',
  graph_degree => 32,
  intermediate_graph_degree => 64
)
ORDER BY query_ordinal, rank;"},"validation":{"function_name":"cuvs_cagra","call":{"relations":{"dataset":{"table":"dataset_vectors"},"queries":{"table":"query_vectors"}},"options":{"k":8,"metric":"l2_expanded","graph_degree":32,"intermediate_graph_degree":64}}}}]
limitations_json: ["Builds and frees its graph and padded dataset during each query execution; executions never share an index.","Approximate search may return fewer than k neighbors; missing (query, rank) rows are omitted and valid ranks remain contiguous.","The dataset must be non-empty, k and intermediate_graph_degree must be less than or equal to its row count, and graph_degree must be less than intermediate_graph_degree.","k must not exceed itopk_size. single_cta requires itopk_size no greater than 1024. cosine cannot use nn_descent.","Dataset and query dimensions and element types must match.","Neighbors and distances can differ slightly between runs, because graph construction orders edges by atomic arrival; there is no seed option."]
